verdict: Paid activity came to a complete halt in the last 7 days, with spend, leads, and CPL all dropping 100% versus the prior period, suggesting Meta campaigns were paused after the 28-day window closed. performance.verdict: Campaigns fully paused 12 days; organic holds but pipeline intake is broken.

findings.text: All paid spend dropped to $0 from 2026-08-06 onward — 12 consecutive zero-spend days confirmed in series; 45 leads and $1,171.64 spend now fully stopped.
GHL pipeline shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments against 33 contacts and 45 leads in 28 days — intake is not converting contacts to opps at all.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): sc_clicks averaged 3.3 vs 21.3 in prior 3 days — a sharp organic search drop coinciding with the paid pause, suggesting paid was supporting branded search.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 then collapsed to 13 by Aug 16 — directional only due to known double-count property, but the spike-and-crash pattern warrants watching.
IG reach fell from ~85 avg daily (active period) to effectively 0 after Aug 11, confirming organic social is tied to paid activity, not independent.

suggestions.text: Reactivate Meta campaigns at prior baseline ~$69/day to restore lead flow; confirm campaigns are not permanently paused.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 12 consecutive days since 2026-08-06, halting all 45 leads that were generated in the prior active period at a $26.04 CPL. Action: reactivate campaigns at the last confirmed daily rate of ~$69/day (matching the 2026-08-05 spend before pause). Success check: at least 1 confirmed lead within 3 days of reactivation and CPL back below $30 by 2026-08-21.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 33 contacts and 0 opportunities created signals intake is broken, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts logged but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window, meaning leads are arriving but never advancing in the pipeline. Action: audit GHL workflow automations and manual intake steps to identify where contacts are stalling. Success check: at least 5 open opportunities created from existing contacts by 2026-08-25, with no new ad spend required.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks 3-day average; if it stays below 10 after Meta reactivation, paid-organic dependency needs investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks dropped from a 21.3 average (Aug 12–14) to 3.3 (Aug 15–17), correlating with the paid pause and suggesting Meta was driving branded search lift. Re-check sc_clicks on 2026-08-21 after Meta reactivation. If the 3-day average remains below 10, escalate for a paid search or branded keyword investigation.
